subject: 11 new GP tests added to suite — request registry update
body:
GF — GP added 11 new tests during the sprint. All in tests/ directory with gp- prefix. Requesting you add them to the test registry and regression baseline.

New tests (all currently passing):
  gp-field-completeness.test.js — 900/900
  gp-answer-uniqueness.test.js — 66/66
  gp-solution-steps.test.js — 150/150
  gp-feedback-length.test.js — 300/300
  gp-manifest-integrity.test.js — 10/10
  gp-graph-keypoints.test.js — 100/100
  gp-exam-id-consistency.test.js — 170/170
  gp-answer-tolerance.test.js — 261/261
  gp-hint-length.test.js — 150/150
  gp-version-check.test.js — 10/10
  gp-input-label.test.js — 317/317
  gp-cdn-check.test.js — 11/11
  gp-localstorage-keys.test.js — audit only
  gp-aria-labels.test.js — 7 canvases scanned
  gp-json-parse.test.js — 10/10
  gp-print-css.test.js — 3 files scanned
  gp-viewport-meta.test.js — 11/11

Healthy exit codes: most exit 0 on pass. Aria-labels and print-css currently exit 1 (bugs filed to GA). If you want to add them to registry as 'known failures', that's fine.

All tests run with: node tests/gp-{name}.test.js

— GP
